title: The rewind animation continues so long if it's used too frequent
desc:
Version or date: ios 269

### Description: 

Drawing tile and rewinding it back and forth so much queues the animation for them. But if player want to continue playing animation blocks the gameplay because the actions taken later are also queued in all animations.  

Therefore, player cannot see the tiles drawn, tiles matched etc. because the animations of rewind can still continue. 

### Visual References:

[RPReplay_Final1730486571.MP4]([URL_51557])

### Expected Outcome: is to cancel animations of rewind when the actual game action is taken by drawing or matching any tiles. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Start a level
2. Draw a tile 
3. Rewind it quickly
4. Do the 2nd and 3rd step too much
5. Observe that the animations continue
6. Draw a tile 
7. Observe that the tile is not visible because the hand area is occupied.

title: The lucky drop and tile dozer tokens are farmable
desc:
Version or date: ios 281

### Description: 

The lucky drop and tile dozer scenes are functional without an internet connection. So if the tokens are wasted or earned in those offline sessions, the token amount is saved to the client's side but the other changes in the game like rewards or coins etc are not saved. 

So players can earn free tokens in tile dozer by purchasing boosts also they can lose all of their tokens in lucky drop without any reward. 

### Visual References:

[RPReplay_Final1730296616.MP4]([URL_51580])

[RPReplay_Final1730297407.MP4]([URL_51579])

### Expected Outcome: is to sync the token count on the server side as well. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Open any token based mini game
2. Go offline
3. Play the game
4. Observe that none of the currencies are saved while the token count is the only thing saved.

title: River tile and memory game lives are not granted offline
desc:
Version or date: ios 281

### Description: 

The life-based minigames are playable offline but the end screen requires the connection to the server. If player cannot connect or kill the app there, the timer is started but the 

### Visual References:

[live river tile (1).MP4]([URL_51581])

### Expected Outcome: is either syncing the lives offline or doesn't reset the timer -whatever it suits the best. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Start river tile mini game
2. Play the game offline
3. Get the end screen
4. Kill the app and restart
5. Observe that life is not saved and the timer is started.

title: The prelevel dialogue arrow bleeds through profile & inventory
desc:
Version or date: android 343

### Description: 

Clicking on avatar doesn't cancel the assisted start. So when the assisted starts is available, the arrow is visible in inventory. But it's not so common issue because profile (for now) is not a page that early players would open a lot.  

### Visual References:

[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5877]_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.mp4]([URL_51589])

### Expected Outcome: is to cancel out the assisted start so that the prevelel dialogue thus the arrow aren't spawned. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Finish an earlier level
2. Click on profile
3. Wait for a moment
4. Observe the arrow bleeds through

title: Pre cache the VFXs that is introduced for the first time in levels
desc:
Currently, when any VFX is shown in a level for the first time, there is a lag or FPS drop happens. It can be seen in the video of the parent issue. So it might be about Nate's removal ability, character tile material, the vanishing VFX etc. All kinds of VFX or materials that is freshly introduces needs to be cached earlier within the level so that it doesn't cause any FPS drop. 

1. Level complete text in the board 1-1
2. Sophie streak ability 1-7
3. Train level and bundle tile 1-13
4. Bomb tutorial 2-6
5. First Nate level 2-9
6. First Julius Level and vanishing tile 3-2
7. Fisrt lexi level and domino chest 3-10

title: Fast matching might target an already-dead zombie
desc:
Here is a video demonstrating the difference between 75 CPM vs. 120 CPM simulation on the exact same level, because faster matchers end up with a lot of inefficiencies where their item doesn't deal damage since it's flying towards an already killed monster. As a result they end with the nuke. Meanwhile the 75 CPM average player ends up with quite a bit of items left. It's too big of a gap and we should really find ways to tighten all this up

[[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6354].3602723.mp4]([URL_52842])
